swerc-1994.notes: Source 1 is the general ETH problem-set archive crawl, not a SWERC 1994 page. Two accounts in it (EchoZem.html, English, Freiburg team member; EchoDerungsUlber.html, German, ETH team members, 'SWERC, der Tag X') concern the 1994 Southwestern European regional and could be report sources of swerc-1994; roles left [] for the crawl as a whole.

sources.evidence: The crawl is of the ETH ACM contest site (captures from 1997 to 2006); its seed page is the 1994 East-Central Regionals problem set (Waterloo), and it holds no problem set or results page of the 1994 Western and Southwestern European contest, only two participant reports on it.
